comments.text: "Be still, and know that I am God" is found in Psalm 46:10. This verse is often interpreted as a call to stop striving, worrying, or panicking, and instead to trust in God's sovereignty and power during chaotic times. It reminds believers to rest in His presence and acknowledge His control.

comments.text:
Amen, hallelujah!! Jesus is starting the events leading to the rapture so very soon. I really want to share this info to give some hope: 

I was given a vision by God of being taken up to heaven from this very apartment I'm living in now. I was called up as I was on my balcony here, I stepped up and saw two others in San Diego go up too. This happened right as a thousand foot tsunami was overtaking downtown. I'm getting evicted from this apartment and I have to be out by the 15th.

I believe my God and he doesn't lie, his word is true and stands firm. This means I'll be going up within the week. I don't think this was the Church's rapture, but it's one of the events leading to the rapture and the three days of darkness. I've heard many testimonies of believers looking out their windows and seeing a wall of water coming fast at them or bomb being dropped with the explosion coming right at them... Right when it was about to hit them... They were transformed and taken to heaven. So even though I only saw only three of us get taken up as the tsunami was hitting downtown, it does not mean that believers won't be saved from harm. 

For the Lord Our God states that we will only look upon the destruction of the wicked, Psalm 91.

This is really exciting to me and I hope it brings joy to a few others. Don't fear, God has it all under control. Jesus knows where we will all be and he has us prepared for what is coming. Get extra food, candles and a heat source for cooking. I don't know how long between the start of these events and the rapture, so be prepared. Love you all, see you soon and God bless you ❤ we fly soon!!!
comments.author: @Sarbear17JesusLovesU

comments.text:
Thanks so much, Melissa. Your videos are always so informative and so honest and straightforward and filled with the spirit. A few months ago in the middle of the night, I was so tired. I was having trouble sleeping and I rose to go to the bathroom and as I walked to the bathroom, I sort of mumbled, “Oh Lord, I am so tired.”
And I heard very loud inside my head in my spirit an answer. I was surprised because I wasn’t really thinking that I was actively praying, but the answer was very clear. The Lord said “Then rest daughter, for you are coming home soon.“ So your video reminded me of that and I think it’s beautiful! Just to add a sidenote…it really touched me that He called me, “daughter,”Because nobody has ever called me, ‘daughter.’ My father was pretty much not in my life. And it really affected me deeply because He used that word!
comments.author: @earthgirlsusan
